simplesect.para: Translated address. For single mode, the address is unchanged. For stacked mode, the lower flash size is subtracted. For parallel mode, the address is divided by 2.
This function gets the actual address to work on the flash. It also selects the CS and BUS based on the detected configuration.

briefdescription.para: Enters or exits the 4-byte addressing mode of the flash device.

detaileddescription.para: As per the Micron and ISSI specifications, a write enable command is issued before the command to enter 4-byte address mode. Macronix and Winbond flash parts do not require write enable.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the QSPIPSU driver component to use.
Mode selection: 1 enters 4-byte mode and 0 exits it.

briefdescription.para: Enables Quad mode for flash parts that need it before Quad commands.

detaileddescription.para: For S25FL-L series flash parts, this is required because the default configuration is x1/x2 mode.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the QSPIPSU driver component to use.
